title: Respiratory Therapeutics
description: Medical record documentation, physician orders, EMR workflows, therapeutic respiratory gases, medical gas storage and delivery systems, flow metering, air-oxygen blending, cylinder duration, Heliox delivery, and oxygen concentrators.

lessons.title: Medical Records, Oxygen & Mixed Gas Therapy
lessons.description: Electronic medical records and charting requirements; common abbreviations; patient record elements; physician, verbal, and telephone orders; five rights verification; therapeutic gases; gas storage and cylinder safety; regulators, flowmeters, blenders, oxygen and Heliox duration calculations; and oxygen concentrator methods.
